verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon). Testing against a sandbox instead of production data is an axis for services and APIs, not for chip hardware, so the story is a category error here. Qualcomm AI Hub's cloud-hosted device profiling is a separate developer service and is not a sandbox-versus-production data separation, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
